remarks: This bright, spacious (1,356 square feet) home features two bedrooms, two full baths, a huge Living Room and Dining Area and Kitchen. Additionally, there are 4 double closets, a walk-in closet and a linen/utility closet. Off the Living Room, the private balcony faces west-southwest providing wonderful views of Long Island Sound, spectacular sunsets year round and on clear days a view of the Manhattan skyline.  Regency Towers provides a live in Superintendent, 24/7 door staff, porter service, closed circuit security around the exterior of the building, in the garage and the Lobby Level, an assigned garage parking space, and on-floor laundry. Heat, hot water and cooking gas are all provided through the HOA fees. Parking space #58 in garage.
